cultural.vision_reason: The photo documents three Cheyenne men in traditional dress (dentalium necklace, hide blankets, leggings, moccasins) with a pack horse, matching the claimed ethnicity as a documentary portrait of their dress and daily life.

physical.title: photographic print (black and white); album
physical.summary:
Photograph (black and white) from an album; portrait of three Cheyenne men, standing beside a horse carrying a bucket; the man on the far left is wearing a hat, a dentalium shell necklace, a tunic, a fur and hide blanket wrapped around himself, a pair of leggings and a pair of moccasins; in the centre, the man wears his hair in two sections wrapped in cloth and wears a blanket wrapped around himself and holds a pipe; the man on the far right wears a fur and hide blanket wrapped around himself, a shirt, and holds a tomahawk(?); a building partially visible in the background; United States of America. 
Albumen print
